lines.text: Zelophehad's five daughters stood before the leaders and the whole congregation at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
They said their father died in the wilderness because of his own sin, and he had no sons.
They asked to be given property among their father's brothers so his name would not disappear from his clan.
Aaron brought their case before the LORD, who said they spoke correctly and to give them their father's inheritance.
A man's inheritance goes to his son, else his widow, else his brothers, else his father's brothers, else clan kin.
